verdict.rationale: Database branching is a fair axis for a database product, but the evidence pack never documents instant copy-on-write branches of schema and data. Backup/restore, point-in-time restore, `cockroach demo` temporary clusters and virtual clusters are adjacent features, not branching, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create an instant copy-on-write branch of my database — schema and data — to develop and test against production-shaped data
